description: Accepted widget executions that fail before a status_message_id exists lose the formatted error and recovery link. Reuse existing MessageFormatter and WebBridge deliver_widget_answer/4 (local transport projection; no new Action). Add regression coverage for formatted credential recovery, stream ordering and synchronous delivery; preserve genuine submission rejections and queued input semantics. Coordinate safe failed-body Markdown rendering with web_widget OpenChamber session ses_ec1d51360ffewsd1tDj9Jq4LXJ.
title: Preserve pre-stream execution errors in WebBridge widget delivery
